body.x: DIGITAL ZONE (CEO Shim Sang-won www.dzonei.com), an exhibit support company of Daegu Mobile Convergence Center, will participate in ‘2013 International Consumer Electronics Show(hear after ‘CES 2013’) held at US, Las Vegas, from Jan.8, 2013 to Jan.11 and introduce HD resolution 2 channel black box ‘WeVo Drive(WD 2000HD)’.

The black box ‘WeVo Drive’ of DIGITAL ZONE can record at the front and the back considering the driver’s safety, with 1280*720 HD quality of 2 channels and 135 angle of view. In addition, it has the functions, such as continuous recording, parking surveillance and the ability to record a video by 3G shock sensor when being shocked.

You can connect your smart phone (iPhone, Android) with Wi-Fi and see real-time video. Also, by downloading video files stored in the black box, you can watch them by your smart phone. ‘WeVO Drive App’ is also expected. In addition, when unexpected accidents happen, it can inform the phone number that users selected and report the accidents to insurance companies.

In addition, it provides various functions including black box firmware easy upgrade support and variety of recording modes (continuous recording, event recording, parking recording and emergency recording), driving speed, driving location identification using high-performance GPS, VOICE GUIDE that inform operation status, sound effects, emergency backup battery support, service information in Google map.

‘CES 2013’ is the world’s largest electronics exhibition hosted by home appliances Manufacturers Association(CEA) whose members are about 600 consumer electronics industry companies of US. In the exhibition, will be introduced all kinds of consumer products such as home network?Mobile?MP3 as well as Audio?Video?Car Audio?Hardware?Software?Satellite receiver?Telephone.

Meanwhile, Daegu Mobile Convergence Center will help 9 domestic mobile IT convergence companies booth lease and facility devices, counseling and interpretation, production shipping, product directory book, as part of national project ‘New Industry Mobile Convergence global competitiveness reinforcement.
